carlton-tower-official-superior.alt: A Superior Room at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: a made-up double bed against a deep green upholstered headboard, pale panelled walls with inset wallcovering, a walnut desk with a brass lamp, and a blue armchair by a window onto the trees of Cadogan Place.

carlton-tower-official-junior-suite.alt: A Junior Suite at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: a large bed with a green headboard, cream wall panels framed in mouldings, a small round table and two chairs, and floor-to-ceiling windows onto a balcony.

carlton-tower-official-garden-suite.alt: The sitting room of a Garden Suite at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: a burgundy velvet sofa with patterned cushions, an oval stone coffee table on a cream rug, brass wall lights on pale panelled walls, and a window table looking out over Cadogan Gardens.

carlton-tower-official-executive-suite.alt: The living room of an Executive Suite at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: cream walls laid out in moulded panels, a landscape painting above a small dining table, a large wall mirror, a burgundy sofa, and a doorway through to the bedroom.

carlton-tower-official-luxury-suite-bedr.alt: A bedroom in a Two Bedroom Luxury Suite at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: a wide bed with a pale ribbed headboard, moulded wall panels with inset wallcovering on every wall, a red armchair, and full-height windows to a balcony above the city.

carlton-tower-official-royal-suite.alt: The long living room of the Royal Suite at Jumeirah Carlton Tower: a navy sofa with patterned cushions, a walnut coffee table, brass wall lights and framed art on pale panelled walls, and a dining area beyond on a herringbone oak floor.
